sources.title: Marc Lackenby, Taut ideal triangulations of 3-manifolds
sources.recorded_inspection_scope: Definition, Theorem 3, introduction construction, Proposition 10 and section 4(2); manuscript pagination.
sources.reliance_and_limits: Explicit fully carried, all-boundary-curves-closed convention; incompressible Reebless homology carrier and incompressible torus-boundary results retain their hypotheses. Openness is asked, not proved.

sources.title: Ian Agol and Tao Li, An algorithm to detect laminar 3-manifolds

sources.reliance_and_limits: Carrier essentiality criterion and lamination existence/detection results; no proved fixed-carrier, prescribed-boundary reduction or termination statement.

sources.title: Jonathan Zung, Veering triangulations and transverse foliations
sources.recorded_inspection_scope: Sections 1, 2.3, 5 and Remark 5.5; retained v1 preprint.
sources.reliance_and_limits: Interval-homeomorphism coordinates and sector gluing in the canonical veering setting; the 10_145 example and its actual peripheral basis. No universal taut-carrier transfer or meridional-filling foliation claim.
sources.inspected_version_status: arXiv:2411.00227v1 (2024), preprint; no claim about a newer version or later publication status.
